title: galium sylvaticum var. typicum
intro: Galium sylvaticum var. typicum, commonly known as Woodland Bedstraw, is a perennial plant species within the Rubiaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from anxiety, insomnia, and restlessness, making it a popular natural remedy for promoting relaxation and improving sleep quality. The plant's therapeutic actions are primarily attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and phenolic glycosides, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The health benefits of Galium sylvaticum var. typicum are multifaceted, with its extracts being used to treat various conditions, including gastrointestinal disorders, fever, and skin issues.
